name: Gated run → stamp agent.loop.run anchor (enable classifier inherit-spawn)
description:
The conversation lane's anchor half (nl-conversation-intent group 4; the dev-from-task/01 two-rule split applied at the approval gate). The classifier spawn (02-spawn-classifier) binds its loop to the gated run via publish_agent run_scope=inherit — and inherit reads the FIRING entity's bare agent.loop.run triple. A run entity carries agent.run.phase / agent.run.entity-id but NEVER a bare agent.loop.run triple on its own: dev-from-task/01 stamps it only at executing+approved, which is AFTER the gate this lane serves. So this rule stamps the missing anchor (agent.loop.run = the bare run id, $entity.instance) the moment the run reaches awaiting_approval, and the spawn rule (a separate rule, next KV revision) can inherit — the same two-rule split as dev-from-task/01+02, because inherit reads the in-memory entity SNAPSHOT captured at evaluation and an add_triple earlier in the same on_enter is invisible to it.

INERT TO EVERYTHING ELSE (reader audit): agentrun.ResolveRun reads agent.loop.run only on LOOP entities, never chain/run entities; every rule that conditions on the run's agent.loop.run (dev-from-task/02 rewake, dev-from-task/03 projection, sandbox/01 provision) ALSO requires run.change.decision eq "approve", which is absent while the run sits at the gate — so pre-stamping the anchor here fires nothing early. Once approval lands, dev-from-task/01's own agent.loop.run length_eq 0 guard sees this anchor already present and simply never fires (it would have stamped the identical value); the kickoff chain proceeds off THIS anchor unchanged.

EDGE-TRIGGERED ONE-SHOT: the agent.loop.run length_eq 0 guard extinguishes the trigger the moment the anchor lands — the house fired-once pattern with the stamped fact itself as the marker (add_triple of the same deterministic value is idempotent on replay). G2: stamps a framework anchor fact, fires no lifecycle transition.

metadata.station: classifier anchor — make the gated run inherit-spawnable (group 4, design D3)
metadata.why_run_entity_stamp: publish_agent inherit derives RunID from the firing entity's bare agent.loop.run triple (actions.go run_scope switch); a run/chain entity has none before dev-from-task/01 fires at executing+approved, so the gate-time classifier spawn cannot bind without this.
metadata.two_rule_split: inherit reads the entity snapshot; an add_triple in the same on_enter is invisible to a same-rule inherit. The inherit publish lives in 02-spawn-classifier.json, fired on a later KV revision once agent.loop.run is present (the spawn conditions on it ne "").
metadata.inert_audit: ResolveRun reads agent.loop.run on loop entities only; the three run-entity readers (dev-from-task/02, dev-from-task/03, sandbox/01) all also require run.change.decision eq "approve", absent at the gate. dev-from-task/01 is superseded-not-broken: its length_eq 0 guard sees this anchor and never fires; the value is identical.
